scope: Bounded decoder regression corpus: all 256 0F01 ModRM values in four execution modes, selected refining prefixes, and selected baseline forms. No exhaustive architectural ISA, interpreter, JIT, flags, fault or Linux qualification is implied. Expected decoded operations describe Dory representation; recognized unsupported operations are not executable support.
